patches_modified.name: AMOLED dark theme
patches_modified.description: Replaces the dark theme background with pure black.

patches_modified.name: Hide upgrade upselling
patches_modified.description: Hides the top-bar upgrade button and promotional sidebar rows.

patches_modified.name: Remove 'Sent from' signature
patches_modified.description: Removes the 'Sent from Proton Mail' signature from emails.

patches_modified.name: Remove free accounts limit
patches_modified.description: Removes the limit for maximum free accounts logged in.

patches_modified.name: Spoof signature
patches_modified.description: Restores push notifications by spoofing the original app signature.

patches_modified.name: Unlock custom time picker
patches_modified.description: Enables picking a custom date and time when snoozing conversations and scheduling messages.

patches_modified.name: Remove pairip protection
patches_modified.description: Removes the Play licensing check that sends a patched install to Google Play.

patches_added.name: Disable review request dialog
patches_added.description: Prevents De'Longhi Comfort from asking to rate the app.

patches_added.name: Restore AC controls on return
patches_added.description: Restores the selected air conditioner and reloads its controls when returning to De'Longhi Comfort.

patches_added.name: Raw H.264 stream
patches_added.description: Low-latency transport for Live streaming: the encoded H.264 is sent to the PC as a plain TCP stream instead of RTMP (~0.2 s glass-to-glass with Standard stabilization). Receive with gst-launch-1.0 tcpserversrc port=6970 ! h264parse ! avdec_h264 ! ... Video only.

patches_added.name: Raw stream connect modes
patches_added.description: Adds "PC via USB" and "PC via Wi-Fi" entries to Live streaming's Connect to list for the raw H.264 transport. USB needs no settings (adb reverse tcp:6970 tcp:6970 on the PC); Wi-Fi takes the PC from the RTMP stream URL field (rtmp://pc-ip).
